purpose: Define direct and group conversations as explicit messaging identities independent from peer identity, transport session and transient Hello rendezvous records.

topics.name: Messaging Conversation Identity
topics.purpose: Define direct and group conversations as explicit messaging identities independent from peer identity, transport session and transient Hello rendezvous records.

semantics.identity_rule: Each conversation has an explicit stable conversation identity.
semantics.direct_rule: Direct conversation references its participating peer identities explicitly.
semantics.group_rule: Group conversation references explicit group membership/governance state.
semantics.transport_rule: Conversation identity survives transport reconnect/session replacement.
semantics.hello_rule: Hello rendezvous record/session identity never becomes conversation identity.
semantics.authority_rule: Conversation membership/visibility is governed independently from transport reachability.

invariants.rule: Messaging is explicit peer/group communication over governed peer transport; rendezvous, transport, conversation policy and message payload remain separate semantic layers.

hard_gates.condition: transport session used as conversation identity
peer identity conflated with conversation identity

references.purpose: Rendezvous remains separate from conversation identity.

prose.summary: Define direct and group conversations as explicit messaging identities independent from peer identity, transport session and transient Hello rendezvous records.
